name: Slonks Merge Manager
description: The live merge manager for Slonks: it burns one Slonk into another, averaging their embeddings so slop only goes up.
about:
## Role in the Slonks system

This is the active merge manager for the **Slonks** NFT (`0x832233ddb7bcffd0ed53127dd6be3f1aa5845108`). Merging picks a survivor token and burns a donor of the same merge level; their embeddings are averaged, the result is re-rendered, and the recomputed slop only increases. It is an authorized metadata updater on the NFT and its state is surfaced to renderers through **SlopGameV2** (`0x76c61b6140600429f50de5ac987e41672047cc28`).

This deployment supersedes an earlier merge manager (`0x3c60eff7b4aff33a3ad5f0b7c9c7d13ba80a422f`), which the current renderer still references as a fallback read but which is no longer the authoritative merge recorder.
